mainEntity.name: Will my stress acne go away immediately after exams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes. Once the cortisol levels drop and your stress stabilizes, your oil production returns to normal. However, Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation (PIH) or scarring from nervous picking can last much longer.

mainEntity.name: How do I flatten a pimple overnight before a viva or practical?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest way is using a Salicylic Acid spot treatment combined with a micro-dart pimple patch. Avoid home remedies like toothpaste, which can cause chemical burns.

mainEntity.name: Why does my skin feel oily but dry during exam season?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is often due to 'ER Stress' from sleep deprivation, which weakens the skin barrier. Your skin produces excess oil to compensate for the lack of moisture, leading to a 'leaky' and irritated barrier.
